title: Rajesh Singh Solanki v. State of U.P.
coram: Surya Prakash Kesarwani, J.; Surendra Singh-I, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; Para 6.8 objection; coercive action stayed.
headnote: Writ against two electricity demand notices disposed of without opinion on merits. Petitioner given liberty to file an objection under Para 6.8 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 before the DISCOM within four weeks; if filed, to be decided in accordance with law within the next four weeks after reasonable opportunity of hearing. Coercive action stayed for eight weeks or until disposal of the objection, whichever is earlier.
facts: Rajesh Singh Solanki challenged before the Allahabad High Court two demand notices dated 13 April 2022 and 17 June 2022, claiming Rs. 28,79,907 plus a Rs. 2,20,000 summon fee, and sought certiorari to quash those notices together with mandamus restraining recovery of checking-team electricity charges. Counsel for the Power Distribution Corporation stated on instructions that the petitioner could file an objection against the impugned demand, which would be decided in accordance with law within a time-bound period.

holding_units.holding: Without expressing any opinion on merits, the writ against the demand notices is disposed of by granting liberty to file an objection under Para 6.8 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 before the DISCOM within four weeks; if so filed, the objection shall be decided in accordance with law within the next four weeks after affording reasonable opportunity of hearing, and no coercive action shall be taken for eight weeks or till disposal of the objection, whichever is earlier.

principle_tags.application: Writ against demand notices disposed by directing a Para 6.8 objection, to be decided after hearing, with stay of coercive action pending that disposal.
The High Court declined merits adjudication and relegated the consumer to the statutory Para 6.8 objection before the DISCOM.

not_decided.point: Validity of the demand notices dated 13.04.2022 and 17.06.2022 and the claimed electricity charges
not_decided.note: Writ disposed of without expressing any opinion on merits.
